changelog: Bla bla bla..
rsg-core bugs have been fixed.
rsg-core bugs have been fixed.
Fixed an issue where items were not appearing in wagon storage after using Move Camp on RSG.
Fixed an issue where the wagon disappeared and caused an error when rejoining the server.
Fixed an issue on VORP where camps lost their zone, map blip and build/storage interactions after rejoining or restarting the server.
Fixed the Move Camp wagon not appearing (and causing an error) after a server restart.
Fixed a crash that could happen after placing more than two props in a camp.
Added a config option to enable/disable camp grass clearing and set its size.
Reduced console spam — extra logs now only show when Debug mode is enabled.
Cleaned up the in-game console — client logs are now hidden unless Debug mode is enabled (server-side/error logs still go to the server console as before).
Fixed a console SQL error on VORP when removing a camp storage prop or a wagon.
Fixed losing the camp item when trying to place a camp inside or at the edge of a town — the item is now returned to you.
Optional: config_items.lua still has some unused 'grassRadius' lines that no longer do anything — you may remove them if you wish, but it's not required (your item settings are safe either way).
SECURITY: Closed a server-side exploit that allowed items to be obtained improperly. Updating is strongly recommended for all servers.
Fixed the client crash that happened on busy servers when players placed camp props. Two separate resource pools were being exhausted; both are now capped.
Fixed camp member permissions not saving, and members not being removable, on RSG servers.
Fixed being unable to found your own camp while you are a member of someone else's camp.
Fixed the camp wagon and everything stored in it being deleted without warning when its owner placed a new camp. The new camp is now refused until the wagon is dealt with.
Storage props no longer destroy their contents. Removing a prop, deleting a camp, moving a camp or scrapping a wagon is refused while storage still holds items, and tells you what is inside.
Items are no longer lost when your inventory is too full to receive them back. The action is refused instead.
Added a per-item limit so one camp can no longer be filled with storage chests. See maxPerCamp in config_items.lua.
Camp storage, installing, removing and deleting now verify you are actually at the camp.
MaxPlayerCreateCamp now works. It was present in the config but never read; the one-camp rule was hardcoded.
Install recipes now check the required amount, not just whether you own one of the item.
NOTE: PropStreamDistance is now 150 (was 500) and a new MaxSpawnedPropsClient cap was added. These are the crash fix. Raise them only if your player count is small.
